Study-level subtype for this paper is ambiguity/uncertainty (decisions under volatile/probabilistic contingencies). The RPE contrast is a group-level, whole-brain task-evoked map acquired within an uncertainty/volatile decision context, so qualifies under AMBIGUOUS_DM_I1 and AMBIGUOUS_DM_I2 in addition to GLOBAL_I1 and GLOBAL_I2.

The model-based learning-rate (LR) whole-brain map is a task-evoked, group-level decision-making contrast related to updating and choice in volatile environments; meets GLOBAL_I1, GLOBAL_I2 and COMMON_DM_I1.

Learning-rate modulation is central to decisions under uncertainty/volatility in this study (contrast indexes LR during volatile vs stable phases). This is a group-level whole-brain map acquired in an ambiguity/uncertainty context, meeting GLOBAL_I1, GLOBAL_I2, AMBIGUOUS_DM_I1, and AMBIGUOUS_DM_I2.
